subject: Customer consent: include security summary in joint customer story
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Permission to reference our SOC 2 summary in joint customer story

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — enjoyed the recording of last week’s implementation walk-through. Nimbus is excited about the joint customer story Redwood proposed. Before you publish or include anything on the marketing site, our legal & security teams asked that we get explicit consent to include a short paragraph referencing our SOC 2 Type II attestation.

Would Redwood be comfortable including a redacted one-paragraph summary of our SOC 2 scope and status? We’d prefer the blurb to say something like: “Nimbus Analytics maintains SOC 2 Type II coverage for data processing related to analytics exports; no customer data is stored beyond retention windows.” If you have a standard phrasing you like to use, please share it and we’ll confirm.

Also — we can attach Nimbus’s public SOC 2 summary (redacted) if that helps the copy.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Head of Partnerships
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: nimbus-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, redacted public summary)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@nimbusanalytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Permission to reference our SOC 2 summary in joint customer story

Alex — thanks for sending the redacted summary and for flagging this. We absolutely want to respect Nimbus’s controls and legal requirements.

Draft approach from our side: we’ll include a short security callout in the case study that mirrors the language you proposed. Suggested copy (feel free to edit):

“Nimbus Analytics maintains SOC 2 Type II coverage for data processing related to analytics exports; Redwood Inference processes only transient analytic payloads and adheres to customer-defined retention settings.”

Can you confirm:
- Is that phrasing acceptable to Nimbus security/legal?
- Any required logo or attribution language?
- Any redaction constraints beyond the public PDF you attached?

We’ll route the final blurb through Legal for a quick check and send the copy back to you for final sign-off. I’ve also attached our case-study draft so you can see where the blurb would appear.

Jordan / Laura — looping you both in for legal/marketing sign-off and to confirm suggested placement.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-case-study.md (contains draft narrative and placeholders for security callout)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: please review Nimbus security blurb for case study (quick)

Jordan / Laura —

Quick ask: Nimbus has provided a redacted SOC 2 summary and asked that we include a one-paragraph security statement in the joint story. Proposed copy is below. Can Legal provide a thumbs up/edits within 48 hours so we can keep Nimbus on their timeline?

Proposed security callout: “Nimbus Analytics maintains SOC 2 Type II coverage for data processing related to analytics exports; Redwood Inference processes only transient analytic payloads and adheres to customer-defined retention settings.”

Notes:
- The customer explicitly requested redactions; their PDF is attached.
- Marketing would like the callout near the top of the case study (right after the hero quote).
- If Legal wants to add a standard Redwood disclaimer (e.g., “Customers’ attestations are provided by the customer and have not been independently audited by Redwood”), happy to include.

Attachments: nimbus-soc2-summary.pdf, draft-case-study.md

Thanks — Soojin

From: Alex Romero <alex@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Permission to reference our SOC 2 summary in joint customer story

Hi Soojin — thanks for the draft and for routing this through your team. Nimbus is fine with the proposed phrasing with one small edit to make the retention language slightly clearer. Please use the following final wording:

“Nimbus Analytics maintains SOC 2 Type II coverage for data processing related to analytics exports. Redwood Inference processes transient analytic payloads under customer-configured retention settings and does not persist customer-identifiable analytics beyond those windows.”

Two quick notes:
- Please list Nimbus as a customer reference on the page without linking to any internal dashboards or customer data.
- We consent to Redwood publishing the redacted SOC 2 summary as an attachment for the case study, provided you remove the internal contact emails (already redacted in our copy).

You have our permission to publish the case study with the approved blurb and the attached redacted SOC 2 summary. If Legal needs anything signed, we can provide a quick approval email or DocuSign confirmation.

Appreciate the partnership — excited to see the final piece.

Best,
Alex Romero
Head of Partnerships
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: nimbus-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted)
